entries.title: Read a PDF for evidence
entries.description: Extract cited claims, tables, or page findings from PDFs and flag scanned, unreadable, or unverified pages.

entries.title: Review a Word document
entries.description: Review a Word draft and give located comments or a revised text version without implying formatting was preserved.

entries.title: Compare document versions
entries.description: Compare available versions by meaning and surface material changes with locations in both sources.

entries.title: Extract actions from documents
entries.description: Turn minutes, briefs, or documents into traceable tasks, decisions, deadlines, and unresolved questions.

entries.title: Inspect spreadsheet data
entries.description: Profile supplied table data and reconcile totals; use workbook features only when the reader exposes them.

entries.title: Clean and reconcile CSV data
entries.description: Clean tabular text with reversible transformations, a change summary, and reconciliation checks.

entries.title: Calculate from tables
entries.description: Answer a quantitative question from supplied tables with explicit units, denominators, and checks.

entries.title: Reconcile two lists
entries.description: Match two tables or exports and report missing, duplicate, and ambiguous records without silently dropping rows.

entries.title: Job Search
entries.description: Find and verify live job openings across job boards and employer sites; separate a shortlist from authorized applications.

entries.title: Research a public question
entries.description: Answer a research question with primary sources, dates, coverage, and explicit gaps.

entries.title: Summarize a web page
entries.description: Extract the concrete takeaways from a specified page without confusing navigation text, snippets, or prior editions with its contents.

entries.title: Compare practical options
entries.description: Create a useful shortlist using evidence, user priorities, and consequential tradeoffs.

entries.title: Write an evidence brief
entries.description: Turn scattered source material into a short brief with findings, evidence strength, and next decision.

entries.title: Draft for a specific audience
entries.description: Write a useful message or short document for its intended reader without sending it.

entries.title: Edit prose for clarity
entries.description: Improve structure, readability, or concision while preserving the author’s meaning and meaningful qualifications.

entries.title: Prepare a project handoff
entries.description: Summarize verified state, current blockers, and the next executable step for someone taking over.

entries.title: Diagnose a software bug
entries.description: Find where a software behavior first diverges using a focused reproduction and evidence.

entries.title: Verify a code change
entries.description: Choose focused regression checks, including controlled browser tests, and distinguish verified behavior from untested paths.

entries.title: Review a code change
entries.description: Find behavior regressions and missing verification in a local patch with actionable findings.

entries.title: Map an unfamiliar code path
entries.description: Trace an input through handlers, state, and output in an unfamiliar repository.

entries.title: Draw a concept diagram
entries.description: Explain a process, relationship, or system with a labeled static SVG and a short text equivalent.

entries.title: Spot-check web accessibility
entries.description: Check a page or short flow for keyboard, focus, and labeling barriers with observed evidence.

entries.title: Tell a story with a chart
entries.description: Turn supplied data into a clear static chart, source note, and explanation of what the evidence shows.

entries.title: Personal Context
aliases: pick up where we left off
entries.description: Use relevant user preferences and earlier project decisions without importing an old task, deadline, or unverified claim. Continue current research even without past-chat lookup.

entries.title: Intent Inference
entries.description: Resolve ambiguous references, date and deadline intent, fresh requests versus resumed work, the user's intended change, and the next useful action without inventing permission or task scope.

entries.title: What Makes Done
entries.description: Define evidence of real completion and take the next useful authorized action when work is unfinished.

entries.title: Critical Path
entries.description: Find the dependency that controls delivery, advance it now, and skip work that will not change the route.

entries.title: Long-Term Judgment
entries.description: Calibrate effort to real reliance, act under uncertainty with a clear undo path, and make complexity earn its place.
